scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-bold

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers must have internal padding.
layout.gridMode: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-6 for dashboard density.
layout.surfaceStrategy: Dashboard Cards: Flat background (#131B2B), 1px border-white/10, no shadow. Hover: -translate-y-1, border-white/20.
layout.header: Crystal Glass: bg-[#0A0F1A]/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10.
layout.sidebar: Sleek, dark vertical sidebar with Phosphor Icons. Muted text until hover/active where it highlights with primary gold.

components.animation: Framer Motion for page transitions, CMD+K search entrance, and hover states. Subtle micro-interactions.
components.data_visualization: Recharts for analytics, styled with primary and secondary accent colors.

command_center_bg.description: Background image for the Welcome/Login or main Dashboard hero.

briefing_room_art.description: Data streams art for the Briefing Room header or empty states.

vault_texture.description: Premium titanium vault texture for the Document Vault background.

executive_office.description: Stylish executive office for onboarding wizard background or general app empty state.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use dark mode exclusively. Do NOT use standard Tailwind blue/zinc defaults. Apply custom colors defined in this JSON.
Implement 'Cabinet Grotesk' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Add the fonts via Google Fonts.
Create a multi-room dashboard layout with a collapsible sidebar and a global CMD+K command palette.
Rooms needed: Briefing Room, Legal Desk, Design Studio, Marketing War Room, Operations Floor, Sales Gym, Vault. Use Phosphor Icons for nav.
Every interactive element MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them: borders should be 1px white/10, backgrounds flat.
For the Vault section, use `vault_texture` as a subtle background or header image with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80).
Use 'command_center_bg' for the Login screen or initial Welcome Onboarding Wizard.
Maintain an '8-year-old logic' (simple, no-fluff) tone in all AI text and UI copy.
Make the UI feel like walking into a high-end corporate command center. Avoid excessive soft shadows; prefer sharp, precise edges with subtle glows.
